text: Fifth Avenue. The old Waldorf-Astoria site.
zh: 第五大道，原华尔道夫酒店的地块。
en: Fifth Avenue. The old Waldorf-Astoria site.
asr: 5th Avenue, the old Waldorf Astoria site.

text: March seventeenth, nineteen thirty. First steel.
zh: 1930 年 3 月 17 日，第一根钢。
九台吊车把钢架吊起来。
有的柱段一段就重 44 吨。

text: Four and a half floors of steel, every week.
en: Four and a half floors of steel, every week.

text: Eighty hours from the mill in Pittsburgh to a rivet in the frame.
zh: 匹兹堡出厂 80 小时，就铆进楼里。
en: 80 hours from the mill in Pittsburgh to a rivet in the frame.

text: The men who did the job?
en: The men who did the job?

text: Twenty-five hundred men a day. Up to four thousand.
zh: 每天 2,500 人，最多一天约 4,000 人。

text: Twelve hundred and fifty feet. The tallest structure in the world.
zh: 1,250 英尺，世界上最高的建筑物。
en: 1,250 feet. The tallest structure in the world.
asr: 1250 feet, the tallest structure in the world.

text: May first, nineteen thirty-one. Open, nearly a month early.
zh: 1931 年 5 月 1 日开放，比计划提前近一个月。
en: 1 May 1931. Open, nearly a month early.
asr: May 1, 1931. Open nearly a month early.
